entries.text: Fixed `MatrixSlice` to follow Python and NumPy slicing semantics: negative steps (such as `X[::-1, :]`) now work, and negative or out-of-bounds slice bounds (such as `X[0:100, :]`) are clipped to the matrix shape instead of raising `IndexError`, including when the matrix has symbolic dimensions.
